verdict.rationale: Kong documents a directory of OpenAPI specifications for its own APIs (kong-docs-9), and its Dev Portal lets developers browse API documentation and try API operations (kong-docs-21, kong-docs-49). However, nothing shows that Kong's own API reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths (kong-probe-2). missing for 10: evidence that Kong's own API reference has try-it/runnable examples, code samples per operation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.
